messages.content: Predict a real participant's allocation in a private Dictator Game. You receive ten equal-value local money coins/bills for this decision and freely distribute all ten between the two labeled cups/envelopes. Each amount must be an integer from 0 to 10 and the two must sum to 10. Close/seal the cups/envelopes after allocating. All allocations are delivered to actual recipients. There is no die rule, negotiation, acceptance decision or veto. You play alone; recipients do not learn who you are, and you are not told their identities. Recipients in different games are different people. A separate participation fee was given before play; its exact amount and this site's coin denomination are unavailable here. The unit below is a count of equal-value local money units, not dollars or a percentage. Only money in a SELF cup is your own game income. When neither cup is SELF, both allocations go to other people, with no retained remainder. LOCAL means an anonymous person of the study's local community/tradition; DISTANT is an anonymous geographically remote person of that tradition. OUTGROUP is an anonymous geographically remote member of the other group selected at that site. Group contrasts can include ethnicity as well as religion; the study labels do not establish your exclusive religious identity. The task uses the current pair of recipients below. Earlier own recorded allocations, if supplied, precede this decision and are not other people's behavior or realized payment feedback. Unavailable history does not mean no earlier decision occurred. Predict behavior without advice or reasons. Output only a JSON object with exactly the two stated cup keys and integer coin counts.
